name: zenith-monorepo
description: CampusConnect Monorepo - Full-Stack AI Operations Intelligence Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && cp -r frontend/.next .next && (cp -r frontend/public ./public 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build --prefix frontend && cp -r frontend/.next .next && (cp -r frontend/public ./public 2>/dev/null || true)
